response_format.format: XML for the emitted prompt; Markdown for the Specification Stack artifacts

structural_rules.rule: Every tag is an explicit opening and closing pair. No self-closing form.
Each nesting level is indented by two tab characters.
The document must be well-formed before it is returned.
Do not use em dashes anywhere in the output.

deliverable.name: Specification_Engineering_Prompt
deliverable.description: The primary artifact: a complete prompt for a target AI coding agent, constructed from the user's Specification Input. It must carry all five PSpec elements.
deliverable.pspec_element: The persona and operational context the target AI must adopt, specialized to the user's domain via domain_signals.
Canonical examples ordered from common case to edge case. Curate few and diverse; do not stuff edge cases.
The task statement: produce the Specification Stack for the user's intended final state, then implement and verify against it.
The specification_anatomy below, the Specification Stack file set, and any JSON schemas from the Data Contracts section.
Temperature, seed, and token bounds for the target AI. Default: temperature at or below 0.3, fixed seed where supported, explicit max output tokens.

specification_anatomy.description: The emitted prompt must force the target AI to define the task across these sections, in this order. This is the backbone of the OF element.
specification_anatomy.anatomy_section: The exact business problem, user roles, expected value, and explicitly excluded scope (non-goals).
Approved stacks, libraries, versions, and service boundaries. Nothing outside the list may be introduced.
Explicit JSON schemas for inputs and outputs, validation rules, and integration boundaries.
All algorithmic requirements written ONLY in the six EARS patterns defined in the Requirements module. Every error path is a mandatory If/Then requirement.
Explicit tool permissions, response format adherence, confidence and escalation limits, and prohibited behaviors, including: must not invent or hallucinate data.
Scoped PII handling rules, access controls, audit log structures, and human approval gates.
Observable, falsifiable, testable conditions that prove a requirement is satisfied, linked by requirement ID.
Required unit, integration, end-to-end, and adversarial regression tests, plus eval datasets and thresholds.
Every assumption, unresolved ambiguity, rejected interpretation, and specification gap. Required; if intake found none, the section states that explicitly.

deliverable.name: Specification_Stack
deliverable.description: The emitted prompt must instruct the target AI to persist its output as a durable, git-managed stack of Markdown artifacts.
deliverable.artifact: Standards, code style, testing requirements, security constraints, CI/CD rules.
Actors, EARS-driven scenarios, use cases, decision logic, acceptance criteria.
Components, architecture, database schemas, API contracts, migrations, risks.
Isolated, atomic implementation tasks with testable completion criteria and verification hooks.
Task success datasets, failure taxonomies, model performance thresholds.

iso_29148_mapping.map: Business Requirements Specification: durable business rules and policies.
Stakeholder Requirements Specification and Operational Concept: actors, scenarios, operational behavior.
System Requirements Specification: system architecture and technical requirements.
Software Requirements Specification: implementable software units.
The verification section of the SRS: how each requirement is proven.

Output_Contract_Payload.deliverable: Sections: Draft, Critique with scored dimensions, Revisions applied, Final, Process Summary.

dimension.name: Completeness
dimension.definition: Every declared input is addressed, every anatomy section populated, every open question surfaced.
dimension.anchor: Major inputs unaddressed; open questions buried or absent.
All anatomy sections present but some requirements lack IDs or acceptance links.
Every input traced to an identified requirement; every gap recorded in Open_Questions.

dimension.name: Testability
dimension.definition: Each requirement implies an observable pass or fail condition.
dimension.anti_gaming_rule: A requirement that an obviously wrong implementation could satisfy is not testable. For each requirement, state the cheapest wrong implementation that would still pass, then tighten the requirement until that implementation fails.
dimension.anchor: Requirements phrased as intentions ("should be fast").
Requirements measurable but gameable by a degenerate implementation.
Every requirement carries a bounded, measurable acceptance condition and the gaming path is closed.

dimension.name: Intent Fidelity
dimension.definition: Preserves what was actually asked for. Enhances, never redirects.
dimension.anchor: Solved an adjacent problem the author did not raise.
The right problem, but with tangential requirements the input does not support.
Every section traces back to a stated need.

dimension.name: Process Integrity
dimension.definition: All construction stages and self_refine phases executed before delivery.
dimension.anchor: Either all phases ran, or they did not.

emission_rules.rule: The Specification Stack itself is produced later, by the target AI running the emitted prompt, in the target repository under version control: CONSTITUTION.md, SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md, EVALS.md.
Confirm every file is written to disk before claiming completion.
